activity.notes: Jean Parisot de Valette (Jean de La Vallette-Parisot in the Order of Malta's own list) served as the 49th Grand Master of the Order of Saint John from 1557 to 1568. During this period the Order exercised territorial government in Malta, including the Great Siege of 1565 and the foundation of Valletta. ATLAS therefore uses Hospitaller Malta as the territorial polity rather than the modern Republic of Malta.
